title: A Twisted bidifferential, second fundamental form of Prym map and projective structures
summary: Given a point $[(\widetilde{C},C)]$ of the moduli space ${\mathcal R}_g$, where $\widetilde{C}$ is an étale double cover of a smooth curve $C$ of genus $g \,\geq\, 7$, we construct a twisted meromorphic bidifferential $\widehatη_P$ on $C\times C$ with a pole on the diagonal. It is shown that the second fundamental form $ρ_P$ of the Prym map from ${\mathcal R}_g$ to ${\mathcal A}_{g-1}$ at $[(\widetilde{C},C)]$ is given by this $\widehatη_P$.
